docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $200.00 FILED BY AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING CENTER AS TO DEFENDANT MISSION TOWING SERVICE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-16-1994 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 03
